How it works

Simple, clear and agreed with you at every stage.

Talk

We discuss your team, your risks and what you want people to be able to do.

Scope

We agree learning outcomes, delivery format, learner requirements and assessments.

Coordinate

We arrange trainers, learners and logistics with the right partners.

Report

You receive evaluation, records and reporting once training is done.

Compliance made less stressful

From records and reporting to selected SDF and SETA admin, we help you keep your skills development paperwork in order so you can focus on running your business.

Frequently asked questions

Is SP Consulting an accredited training provider?

No. We coordinate training through appropriately accredited provider partners, facilitators, assessors and moderators, within their approved scope.

Who do you work with?

Businesses, public-sector organisations, NGOs and training-provider partners.

Where does training take place?

In a classroom, on site at your workplace, virtually, as blended learning or as practical workshops.

Can training be tailored to us?

Yes. Non-accredited programmes are designed around your needs, and every project starts with a conversation about outcomes.

Can you help with WSPs and ATRs?

Yes, where agreed. This is offered as an additional service alongside training.

Tell us what your team needs to learn.
